Welcome to University of Layyah
A Place of Innovation, Growth & Excellence
Vice Chancellor's Message
It is indeed an honor for me to be the Vice Chancellor of the University of Layyah (UL), Layyah. It was my passion to lead an institute of higher learning engaged in enlightening the youth to have a well-lived life alongwith opportunities for entrepreneurship and employment.
I will try to contribute all my efforts to make this University the best one by enabling students and faculty through modern teaching methods, practical education & collaborative research across the spectrum of challenges and opportunities prevailing over the globe.
I welcome you to learn, explore and grow with the latest, updated and sustainability-oriented knowledge and skills to meet the competitive challenges of this modern era.
I wish you a successful and promising educational journey with UL open to all genders and the students of all areas!
Prof. Dr. Muhammad Zubair Abu Bakar

title: University Central Library
text:
University Central Library
University Central Library
Chief Librarian
Librarian's Message
Welcome to the portal of Central Library University of Layyah. Our aim is to provide the best information and reference services for the users in line with ever changing trends in information and communication technology and the current needs of the university throughout the globe.
The library supports the academic programs of the university through its services, which enable the students and the faculty to access, update their knowledge and information. This support empowers our users to develop the information and technological competencies necessary to achieve their educational, research and professional goals.
In the library of the University, you will find wonderful spaces where you can access a wide range of digital resources to support your teaching, learning, and research activities. We are honored to work with all staff of the University of Layyah, library team and our community of learners.
About the Library

title: University Central Library
text:
University Central Library
About the Library
The University of Layyah Library serves as a central hub for academic resources, supporting the educational and research needs of students and faculty. With a rich collection of textbooks, reference materials, research journals, and digital resources, the library fosters an environment of independent learning and intellectual growth.
The library is equipped with modern facilities including high-speed internet access, digital catalogues, reading rooms, and computer stations. It is fully automated and offers an online library system for efficient book search and borrowing services.
Whether you're preparing for an exam, conducting research, or just exploring new ideas, the University Library offers a peaceful and resource-rich environment to help you succeed.

title: Scholarships & Financial Aid
text:
Scholarships & Financial Aid
Scholarships & Financial Aid
Empowering Dreams Through Education
Introduction
The University of Layyah is committed to promoting academic excellence and accessibility through a variety of scholarships and financial aid opportunities. These programs are designed to support talented, hardworking, and financially deserving students, ensuring that no student is deprived of quality education due to financial constraints.
Scholarships are awarded purely on merit, need-based, or special criteria established by donors and university regulations. Students are encouraged to apply and take advantage of the opportunities to fund their education.
Available Scholarships

Need-Based Financial Aid
Ehsaas Undergraduate Scholarship
Punjab Educational Endowment Fund (PEEF)
Orphan/Disabled Student Scholarships
Minority Student Scholarships
Faculty/Staff Children Concessions
How to Apply
Eligible students can apply for scholarships by submitting the required documents to the Scholarships & Financial Aid Office. The announcements are made through the university notice board and official website. Each scholarship has specific deadlines and eligibility criteria, so timely submission is crucial.
The university also conducts awareness seminars and guidance sessions to help students complete the process effectively and ensure maximum participation.

title: Transport Facility
text:
Transport Facility
Transport Facility
Connecting Students to Campus Comfortably
Message from Incharge Transport
At University of Layyah, we recognize the importance of safe and efficient transportation for students and staff. Our transport department ensures timely, comfortable, and cost-effective commuting services connecting key areas of the city with the campus. We are committed to maintaining high safety standards, regular maintenance, and passenger satisfaction.
Our goal is to provide hassle-free travel so students can focus on what matters most — their education.
Dr. Azhar Abbas Khan
Incharge Tranport
About Our Transport Services
The Transport Facility of University of Layyah provides regular pick-and-drop services for students and staff from various routes in and around Layyah city. Our transport fleet is well-maintained, operated by trained drivers, and monitored to ensure safety, punctuality, and efficiency.
Timely services and scheduled maintenance checks are the core of our transport management to ensure uninterrupted and comfortable commuting.
Key Features
Air-conditioned & Non-AC buses
Designated pick-up/drop points
Separate buses for male & female students
Trained drivers and punctual schedule
Affordable monthly transport passes
Emergency contact availability on all buses

title: Quality Enhancement Cell
text:
Quality Enhancement Cell
Quality Enhancement Cell
Prof. Dr. Azhar Abbas Khan
Director QEC
Introduction
Quality Enhancement Cell has been established for assurance of quality in teaching as well as other academic activities to meet the global challenges of education. The main focus of the QEC is implementation of the policies of the HEC for quality assurance and the monitoring of degree programs offered by the University of Layyah to promote skill-based learning. The system maintains and identifies the outcomes of educational programs, implements and reviews systems and tools for quality assessment, and develops appropriate data collection methods.
Vision
Our vision is to make Quality Enhancement Cell of the University of Layyah competitive with the standards of national and international institutes.
Mission
Our mission is to strengthen quality of education in the University of Layyah by fulfilling requirements and satisfaction of all the stakeholders by developing quality assurance policies, automating the assessment processes in collaborating with statutory bodies.
Objectives
Implementation of the assessment procedures and measures of HEC for the promotion of quality culture at University of Layyah.

BSCS - Information Technology (BSCS-IT)
Program Overview
The
Bachelor of Science in Information Technology (BSIT)
is a
four-year undergraduate program
designed to develop professionals who can effectively plan, implement, and manage information systems and emerging technologies in modern organizations. The program bridges the gap between
computer science, business management, and communication technologies
, preparing graduates for diverse roles in today’s digital economy.
In an era where technology drives innovation and competitiveness, BSIT graduates play a critical role in supporting and leading the development of
software systems, networks, databases, and enterprise solutions
. The curriculum is structured according to the
Higher Education Commission (HEC) of Pakistan’s guidelines
, incorporating both
technical depth and managerial perspective
to meet industry and academic standards.
Program Objectives

Program Overview
The
Bachelor of Science in Artificial Intelligence (BSAI)
is a
four-year undergraduate degree program
designed to prepare students for the rapidly evolving world of intelligent systems and data-driven technologies. The program aims to equip students with a strong foundation in
computer science, mathematics, machine learning, deep learning, data analytics, and cognitive computing
, enabling them to design, develop, and deploy intelligent systems that solve real-world problems.
Artificial Intelligence is transforming industries globally — from healthcare and finance to education, agriculture, and smart cities. This program has been carefully designed in line with the
Higher Education Commission (HEC) of Pakistan’s curriculum
and the
latest international standards
, ensuring that graduates possess both
technical competence and ethical awareness
to meet the challenges of the 21st century.

The primary objectives of the BSCS- AI program are to:
Provide students with a
strong theoretical foundation
in the core areas of computer science, mathematics, and artificial intelligence.
Develop
practical skills
in designing and implementing AI-based systems and applications.

Academic Excellence
Welcome to the Department of Biosciences
The Department of Biosciences at the
is a thriving center of biological education and research, dedicated to understanding life at molecular, cellular, organismal, and ecological levels.
The Department is committed to nurturing scientific curiosity, critical thinking, and research excellence, empowering students to explore the vast and dynamic world of biological sciences.
As biosciences form the foundation of modern healthcare, biotechnology, environmental science, and agricultural innovation, the Department emphasizes a balanced blend of theoretical concepts, laboratory training, and research-based learning. Students engage with cutting-edge scientific techniques and develop the analytical skills required to address real-world biological challenges.
Molecular Level
Decoding DNA, proteins, gene regulation, and biochemical pathways.
Cellular Level
Investigating microscopic organisms, cell signalling, and cytology.
Organismal Level
Understanding physiological systems, growth, anatomical adaptations, and health.
Ecological Level
Exploring ecosystems, biodiversity conservation, and environmental safety.

The

stands as a vital academic unit dedicated to understanding the mechanisms of disease in animals, microorganisms, and the environment. , the Department equips students with the academic and practical skills necessary to address emerging challenges in animal health, zoonotic diseases, and modern disease diagnostics. Department Overview
The
Department of Entomology & Food Science
at the
is committed to advancing education, research, and innovation in the vital areas of
insect science, food safety, and sustainable agriculture
. This department offers a unique interdisciplinary approach that combines the study of
insects, crop protection, and food quality management
, preparing students to address the challenges of food security and agricultural sustainability in Pakistan and beyond.
Insects play a crucial role in
ecosystem balance, pollination, pest management, and food production
. At the same time, maintaining food quality and safety is a national priority for health and economic growth. The Department of Entomology & Food Science integrates these two domains —
understanding insect biology and managing food systems
— to ensure sustainable agricultural productivity and safe, nutritious food supplies for society.

Program Introduction
Overview
Biotechnology is at the forefront of major advances in life sciences. Biotechnology refers to the use of plants, animals and microorganisms to create new products or processes. It plays an important role in helping industry, medicine and agriculture to produce foods and medicines, manage disease and pests, and clean up the environment.

title: BS Biotechnology
text:
BS Biotechnology
Biotechnology is an applied science that uses the tools of biochemistry, molecular biology and other fields of biology to solve problems that affect humans. Bringing together several scientific disciplines, our course produces graduates who have a high standard of cognitive, practical and transferable skills and the knowledge to begin careers in medical research, in hospital and public health laboratories, and also in the pharmaceutical, food and agricultural industries. Analytical, numerical and communication skills developed by biotechnology graduates are also in demand in non science-based careers such as accountancy, journalism and marketing.
Students will be able to explore the molecular, cellular and physiological bases of life processes, and develop the intellectual and practical skills necessary for the collection, analysis, interpretation and understanding of biotechnology information and data. You will also develop awareness of the ethical implications of the complex biotechnological issues presented in the contemporary world and develop skills of reflection and self-evaluation.

Program Objectives
The MSc (Hons) in Plant Breeding & Genetics program is designed to develop advanced knowledge, practical competence, and research skills in plant breeding, genetics, and crop improvement. The program prepares graduates to contribute to sustainable agricultural development, enhanced crop productivity, food security, and the development of climate-resilient varieties.
The specific objectives of the program are to:
Develop advanced knowledge of classical, quantitative, molecular, and modern approaches to plant breeding and genetic improvement.
Build practical competence in crop breeding, field experimentation, genetic evaluation, and statistical analysis of breeding data.
Provide training in contemporary tools and techniques, including molecular markers, biotechnology, tissue culture, genomics, and molecular breeding.
Develop research skills for the identification, evaluation, and effective utilization of genetic diversity in crop improvement.
Strengthen students’ critical thinking, analytical reasoning, and problem-solving abilities for addressing current challenges in agriculture.

title: M.Sc. (Hons.) Plant Breeding & Genetics
text:
M.Sc. (Hons.) Plant Breeding & Genetics
Strengthen students’ critical thinking, analytical reasoning, and problem-solving abilities for addressing current challenges in agriculture.
Promote professional communication, teamwork, research ethics, and scientific skills required in academic, research, and agricultural sectors.
Prepare graduates for advanced research and doctoral studies as well as professional careers in universities, research organizations, seed industries, and biotechnology-related fields.
Program Description
The MSc (Hons) in Plant Breeding & Genetics is a two-year postgraduate degree program that provides comprehensive education and practical training in the genetic improvement of crop plants. The program builds upon fundamental concepts of genetics and plant breeding and incorporates contemporary developments in molecular biology, biotechnology, and quantitative genetics.
The program provides students with opportunities to develop practical skills in field experimentation, hybridization, selection, genetic evaluation, biometrical analysis, and laboratory-based breeding techniques. Particular emphasis is placed on genetic variability, heritability, selection strategies, hybrid development, resistance breeding, and the improvement of crop performance under diverse and changing environmental conditions.

title: M.Sc. (Hons.) Plant Breeding & Genetics
text:
M.Sc. (Hons.) Plant Breeding & Genetics
Coursework is integrated with practical activities, research projects, and thesis research to develop students’ scientific, analytical, and problem-solving abilities. Students gain experience in designing and conducting experiments, collecting and analyzing data, interpreting research findings, and communicating scientific results.
The program is supported by qualified faculty members and research facilities that provide students with opportunities for practical learning and research in plant breeding and genetics. The curriculum is designed to prepare graduates for professional careers in agricultural research, academia, seed and biotechnology industries, government departments, and related agricultural organizations, while also providing a foundation for pursuing PhD studies in Plant Breeding & Genetics and allied disciplines.
Career Outcomes
Graduates of the MSc (Hons) in Plant Breeding & Genetics program acquire knowledge and practical research skills applicable to crop improvement, agricultural research, seed production, biotechnology, and related fields. The degree provides opportunities for employment in public-sector institutions, universities, research organizations, private seed companies, and other agricultural enterprises.
Depending on their qualifications and professional experience, graduates may pursue careers as:
Research Officers, Scientific Officers, or technical personnel in agricultural research organizations.

Department of Islamic Studies and Languages
The
Department of Islamic Studies and Languages
at the
is dedicated to fostering intellectual growth, moral development, and cultural understanding through the study of Islam and linguistic heritage. The Department serves as a center for academic excellence where students explore the foundations of Islamic thought, classical scholarship, contemporary issues, and the rich traditions of language and literature.
Through a balanced combination of
theoretical learning, analytical inquiry, and practical engagement
, the Department aims to prepare graduates who can contribute meaningfully to religious education, research, social guidance, and cultural preservation. Students are encouraged to develop strong ethical values, critical reasoning, and a deep appreciation for linguistic and spiritual heritage.

BS Islamic Studies

title: Department of Islamic Studies and Languages
text:
Department of Islamic Studies and Languages
Academic Programs Offered
BS Islamic Studies
This program follows
HEC guidelines
and focuses on Quranic studies, Hadith, Islamic jurisprudence, Islamic history, comparative religion, and Islamic philosophy, along with coursework in Arabic and other classical languages. The curriculum is designed to strengthen students’ understanding of Islamic knowledge while enhancing their linguistic abilities and research competencies.
Vision and Mission
The
vision
of the Department is to become a leading center for Islamic scholarship and linguistic excellence, nurturing individuals who uphold ethical values and contribute to religious, cultural, and academic advancement.
The
mission
is to cultivate knowledgeable, responsible, and research-oriented graduates who can serve society as educators, scholars, counselors, and cultural ambassadors.
Learning Environment
The Department provides an
intellectually rich and spiritually grounded learning atmosphere
, supported by highly qualified faculty members specializing in Islamic studies, Arabic, linguistics, and related fields. Students gain hands-on experience through:
Research projects and scholarly writing
Quranic and Hadith interpretation sessions
Linguistic analysis and translation practice
Seminars, workshops, and academic forums
Community outreach and educational activities

title: Department of Islamic Studies and Languages
text:

Career Prospects
Graduates from the Department of Islamic Studies and Languages are well-prepared for careers in:
Religious education and teaching
Islamic research institutions
Translation and linguistic services
Community leadership and counseling
Public sector roles related to religion and culture
Media, writing, and cultural preservation
They also have strong potential for higher studies (MS, MPhil, PhD) in Islamic Studies, Arabic, linguistics, and related disciplines at national and international institutions.

BS Sociology
1. Mission
The Department of Sociology is committed to providing students with a comprehensive understanding of the social, cultural, and institutional dimensions of society and the processes through which societies transform over time. It seeks to prepare students to become informed, responsible, and constructive members of society through a rigorous academic curriculum that develops sociological knowledge, analytical abilities, critical thinking, and an understanding of diverse social realities. For this purpose, the academic programs are designed to enable students to connect their learning with contemporary social challenges and future academic and professional pathways.
2. Vision

title: Department of Sociology
text:
Department of Sociology
2. Vision
The vision of the Department of Sociology is to equip graduates with sound theoretical and practical knowledge of social life through quality teaching, research, critical inquiry, and community engagement. The main aim of the department is to develop socially responsible graduates who can apply sociological knowledge and research skills to understand and address emerging social issues at local, national, and global levels.
3. Introduction of the Department
The Department of Sociology is one of the prominent academic departments of the University of Layyah. It was established in 2010 under the BZU Bahadur Sub-Campus, Layyah. In response to the growing academic and social demands of the region, the Department initiated Master's and Bachelor's degree programs in Sociology.
The academic programs offered by the Department provide students with a broad understanding of society and are designed around a multidisciplinary approach. The Department currently offers Post-AD Sociology and BS Sociology programs, providing students with opportunities to develop theoretical understanding, research competencies, and practical knowledge relevant to diverse social and professional contexts.

title: Department of Sociology
text:
Department of Sociology
Over the years, numerous students have graduated from the Department and have pursued academic and professional careers in a variety of fields. The Department is supported by qualified and dedicated faculty members who strive to facilitate students' academic and professional development. Through comprehensive coursework, research activities, and intensive academic training, the Department seeks to prepare graduates for participation in an increasingly diverse and competitive employment environment.
4. Message from the Head of the Department
The Department of Sociology at the University of Layyah is committed to providing students with a strong foundation in sociological knowledge and equipping them with the ability to apply social research to contemporary social issues and policy development at national and international levels. It seeks to develop students' analytical thinking, critical inquiry, research competencies, and ability to establish meaningful connections among different areas of sociological knowledge and their practical applications in everyday life.

Research constitutes an integral component of the academic activities of the Department of Sociology. Faculty members actively contribute to the development of sociological scholarship through research articles, book chapters, and books published in national and international research journals.
Faculty members also contribute to the academic and scholarly community through participation in editorial and advisory boards of reputable journals. The Department encourages students to develop research competencies and supports them in undertaking research and disseminating their findings through appropriate academic platforms.

8. Core Research Areas
The Department of Sociology promotes research across a broad range of sociological and interdisciplinary areas, including Globalization and Social Development; Population Issues; Sociology of Health and Family; Race, Class, Gender, and Inequality; Family Issues; Women's Empowerment; Labour Rights; Social Problems of Pakistan; Crime and Society; Knowledge, Attitudes, and Practices (KAP) Studies; Culture and Society; Sociology of Education; Environmental Sociology; Ethnicity; Human Rights; Inequality, Poverty, and Social Mobility; Political Sociology; Social Movements; Social Demography; Sociology of Religion; Urban and Community Studies; and Work and Labour Markets.
9. Career Opportunities
A degree in Sociology provides graduates with diverse opportunities across government institutions, non-governmental organizations, development agencies, research organizations, educational institutions, social welfare services, and community-based organizations.

A degree in Sociology provides graduates with diverse opportunities across government institutions, non-governmental organizations, development agencies, research organizations, educational institutions, social welfare services, and community-based organizations.

Bachelor of Science in Environmental Sciences (BS ES)
is a
four-year undergraduate degree program
designed to provide students with a comprehensive understanding of the environment, natural resources, and the challenges arising from human interactions with the natural world. The program integrates
biology, chemistry, physics, geology, ecology, and social sciences

title: BS Environmental Sciences
text:
BS Environmental Sciences
biology, chemistry, physics, geology, ecology, and social sciences
to prepare students for addressing complex environmental problems in a sustainable and scientifically sound manner.
Environmental issues such as
climate change, pollution, biodiversity loss, and resource depletion
have become global concerns. This program equips students with the knowledge and analytical skills to understand these issues and develop
innovative, evidence-based solutions
for sustainable development. The curriculum follows the
Higher Education Commission (HEC) of Pakistan’s approved guidelines
, ensuring academic rigor and relevance to both national and international environmental priorities.
Program Objectives
The BS Environmental Sciences program aims to:
Provide an interdisciplinary understanding of
environmental systems, processes, and management
Equip students with skills in
data collection, laboratory analysis, and environmental assessment
Develop competence in
environmental policy, planning, and sustainable resource management
Foster
critical thinking, research skills, and problem-solving
in tackling environmental challenges.
Promote
awareness of environmental ethics and sustainable development practices

Department Overview
The Department of Chemistry at the University of Layyah is dedicated to excellence in teaching, research, and innovation in the field of chemical sciences. Chemistry, often referred to as the central science, explores the nature of matter, its composition, structure, properties, and the transformations it undergoes. It serves as the foundation for understanding processes across physics, biology, medicine, and engineering.
Our department provides students with a comprehensive understanding of chemical principles, ranging from molecular structures and reactions to nanotechnology, medicinal chemistry, environmental chemistry, and industrial applications. The study of chemistry enables students to understand and influence the material world, paving the way for advancements in pharmaceuticals, green chemistry, materials science, biotechnology, and sustainable technologies.
Vision and Mission
The vision of the Department of Chemistry is to produce skilled, ethical, and innovative chemists who contribute to scientific progress, industry, and national development.
Our mission is to:
Deliver a high-quality educational experience grounded in both theory and practical application.

Our mission is to:
Deliver a high-quality educational experience grounded in both theory and practical application.
Encourage research, innovation, and interdisciplinary collaboration in emerging fields of chemistry.
Promote ethical values, critical thinking, and scientific integrity among students.
Prepare graduates to play a leading role in industry, academia, research, and public service.
Academic Programs
The department offers undergraduate programs that follow the Higher Education Commission (HEC) of Pakistan’s curriculum and modern international standards. Our programs emphasize hands-on laboratory training, scientific reasoning, and research-based learning, preparing students for diverse career paths in education, chemical industries, research institutions, and environmental management.
Students are trained in analytical chemistry, organic and inorganic chemistry, physical chemistry, and biochemistry, along with exposure to advanced instrumental techniques and computational methods.

Candidates holding a BS/MSc. Chemistry degree in any discipline/major. Candidates with 16 years of education BS (4 years)/M.Sc. (2 years) in Chemistry or Equivalent are also eligible.
Academic Requirement:
Minimum CGPA of 2.50 out of 4.00 in BS/MSc (semester system) and 50% in MSc. (annual system).

University of Layyah and UET University of Engineering and Technology, Lahore Forge Historic Partnership: Boosting Academic and Technological (Digital) Collaboration
Today, November 14, 2025, the UL took a monumental step towards academic and technological advancement by formally signing two crucial Memorandums of Understanding (MoUs) with the University of Engineering and Technology (UET) Lahore. This landmark ceremony was held at the Vice Chancellor’s Office, UET Lahore.
Key Memorandums of Understanding:

title: MOU Between University of Layyah and UET
text:
MOU Between University of Layyah and UET
Key Memorandums of Understanding:
* Primary Academic and Research Collaboration (UL and UET):
This primary MoU was signed by the Vice Chancellor UL, Prof. Dr. Muhammad Zubair Abu Bakar and the Vice Chancellor UET, Prof. Dr. Shahid Munir (TI). This agreement aims to elevate educational standards through joint academic and research projects, faculty/student exchange programs, digital collaboration, and capacity building initiatives.
* Specialized MoU for Technology and LMS Deployment (UL and KICS-UET):
The second, highly significant MoU was signed between the Al-Khawarizmi Institute of Computer Science (KICS), UET, and the UL. Under this agreement, UET’s cutting-edge Learning Management System (Campus Solution 360) will be deployed at the UL.
* Signatories: Dr-Zeshan Khokhar, Incharge IT at UL, and Mr. Ali Muzaffar from KICS-UET, formalized this specialized collaboration. Mr. Mudassir was also present there alongwith team members of KICS-UET.

title: MOU Between University of Layyah and UET
text:
MOU Between University of Layyah and UET
* Signatories: Dr-Zeshan Khokhar, Incharge IT at UL, and Mr. Ali Muzaffar from KICS-UET, formalized this specialized collaboration. Mr. Mudassir was also present there alongwith team members of KICS-UET.
* Impact: This deployment is a game-changer for UL. It not only modernizes our academic process starting from student admissions untill award of degree, including administrative and financial management but, crucially, connects the UL to one of Higher Education Commission, Pakistan’s main Data Centres (The Gold Mine). This marks a massive leap forward for UL’s IT infrastructure and provides a robust foundation for our digital future.

Program Introduction
Overview
Biotechnology is at the forefront of major advances in life sciences. Biotechnology refers to the use of plants, animals and microorganisms to create new products or processes. It plays an important role in helping industry, medicine and agriculture to produce foods and medicines, manage disease and pests, and clean up the environment.
Biotechnology is an applied science that uses the tools of biochemistry, molecular biology and other fields of biology to solve problems that affect humans. Bringing together several scientific disciplines, our course produces graduates who have a high standard of cognitive, practical and transferable skills and the knowledge to begin careers in medical research, in hospital and public health laboratories, and also in the pharmaceutical, food and agricultural industries. Analytical, numerical and communication skills developed by biotechnology graduates are also in demand in non science-based careers such as accountancy, journalism and marketing.

title: BS Biotechnology
text:
BS Biotechnology
Students will be able to explore the molecular, cellular and physiological bases of life processes, and develop the intellectual and practical skills necessary for the collection, analysis, interpretation and understanding of biotechnology information and data. You will also develop awareness of the ethical implications of the complex biotechnological issues presented in the contemporary world and develop skills of reflection and self-evaluation.
Participants who graduate in biotechnology will understand the interdisciplinary nature of biotechnology and have the special skills and knowledge of food and environmental microbiology and natural-products chemistry that are relevant and sought after by local and international industries. Our highly-regarded courses offer intensive learning, with a strong research focus aimed to equip graduates with the skills necessary to work in the sector. Our subjects are lecture and enquiry based, involving small-group workshops and tutorials.

The Livestock Assistant Diploma at the University of Layyah is a practical, skill-based program aimed at preparing trained professionals to support veterinary and livestock services in rural and urban communities. This two-year diploma focuses on animal health care, disease prevention, vaccination, breeding practices, and basic treatment procedures. Students receive hands-on training through fieldwork, laboratory sessions, and clinical exposure under the supervision of experienced faculty. Graduates of this program play a vital role in improving livestock productivity and promoting animal welfare, making them valuable contributors to the agricultural economy and public health sector.

Dr. M. Rehan Abbas is an Assistant Professor in the Department of Information Technology at the University of Layyah, Pakistan. He earned his PhD in Computer Science with a specialization in Machine Learning from the University of Azad Jammu and Kashmir Muzaffarabad.
‎His research interests include Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Data Analytics, and Applied Data Science. He has published several international research articles in reputable journals and has contributed innovative machine learning methodologies such as Accuracy Rejection Normalized Cost Curves (ARNCCs), PReP Method, and ER Bagging.
‎Dr. Rehan possesses expertise in R programming, predictive modeling, statistical analysis, and research methodology. He is actively involved in teaching, research, student mentoring, and institutional development, with a commitment to applying emerging technologies to solve real-world challenges and promote innovation.

He is an experienced sociologist with professional expertise in teaching, social development, rehabilitation and restoration, social research, poverty alleviation, social mobilization, and community development.
He has professional experience with national and international organizations and has been associated with organizations and development partners including the World Bank, UNICEF, CAMP, WHO, PSPU, AKU, and various national NGOs and field partners. His areas of professional competence include qualitative and quantitative research, marketing research, analytical skills, interpersonal communication, community engagement, and presentation skills.
Dr. Aamir Hayat has published research in national and international journals and contributes to academic and research activities in the field of Sociology.
Areas of Interest: Social Development, Qualitative Research, Quantitative Research, Social Demography, Women's Empowerment, and Social Risk Management.

title: Introduction to Plant Breeding and Genetics
text:
Introduction to Plant Breeding and Genetics
Ms. Zeba Shahnaz
The session combined theory with creativity, as students were encouraged to construct their own
3D DNA models
using various materials. This hands-on activity helped them visualize the
double helix structure
, including the arrangement of the sugar-phosphate backbone and nitrogenous base pairs, reinforcing theoretical knowledge through practical application.
Through this creative exercise, students gained a deeper understanding of how
genetic information is stored, replicated, and transmitted
in living organisms. They also explored how
genetic variation and inheritance patterns
are crucial to plant breeding and crop improvement.
At the end of the session, students presented their DNA models to the class, confidently explaining the structure, components, and biological significance of DNA — turning complex concepts into tangible learning experiences.
“Learning by doing transforms understanding into discovery. When students build knowledge with their hands, they also build confidence in their minds.” —
Ms. Zeba Shahnaz

Department Overview
The
Department of Economics and Business Administration
at the
University of Layyah
is a dynamic and progressive academic unit committed to excellence in
teaching, research, and professional development
. The department’s mission is to cultivate a generation of
economists, entrepreneurs, and administrators
equipped with the analytical, managerial, and leadership skills required to navigate and succeed in an increasingly globalized world.
Our programs are designed to blend
economic theory, business principles, and practical applications
, ensuring that graduates possess the intellectual foundation and professional competence to contribute effectively to both
the public and private sectors
. The department fosters
critical thinking, ethical decision-making, innovation, and social responsibility
, preparing students to become effective leaders, policymakers, and change agents in their respective fields.

Programs Offered
The Department currently offers a diverse range of undergraduate programs to meet the evolving educational and professional needs of society:

Each program combines
theoretical learning with practical exposure

, global business trends, and the changing dynamics of the national economy.

Develop students’ understanding of
economic systems, business management, and global markets
Equip graduates with
leadership, communication, and analytical skills
for diverse professional environments.
Foster a culture of
research, innovation, and entrepreneurship

The Department of Economics and Business Administration provides a

Faculty members bring together

, ensuring students gain insights that connect theory with real-world practice. The department also emphasizes
professional grooming, communication skills, and career readiness
, making its graduates highly competitive in both local and international markets.

text:
University of Layyah - Admissions, How to Apply & Eligibility
# University of Layyah - Admissions, How to Apply & Eligibility
## How to Apply for Admission
1. Visit the online admission portal: https://ul.edu.pk/page/How-to-Apply
2. Register an account with your CNIC/B-Form and active email address.
3. Fill in your personal details, academic qualifications (Matric, Intermediate/FSc/FA/DAE).
4. Select your desired degree program(s).
5. Generate and download the admission processing fee challan voucher from https://ul.edu.pk/challan.
6. Pay the challan at the designated bank branch (usually Bank of Punjab / HBL) or online.
7. Upload the paid fee voucher receipt on the portal and submit the application before the deadline.
## General Eligibility Criteria
- **BS Programs (4 Years):** Minimum 45% to 50% marks in Intermediate (FA / F.Sc / ICS / I.Com / DAE) or equivalent qualification from a recognized board.
- **BS Computer Science / AI / Data Science / IT:** F.Sc Pre-Engineering, ICS, or General Science with Mathematics (minimum 50% marks).
- **B.Sc Computer Engineering:** F.Sc Pre-Engineering with Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry (minimum 60% marks and entry test ECAT if applicable).

title: University of Layyah - Admissions, How to Apply & Eligibility
text:
University of Layyah - Admissions, How to Apply & Eligibility
- **B.Sc Computer Engineering:** F.Sc Pre-Engineering with Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry (minimum 60% marks and entry test ECAT if applicable).
- **Post-ADP Programs (5th Semester):** 14 years of education (BA / B.Sc / ADP / Associate Degree) in relevant subject with at least 45% marks or 2.0 CGPA.
- **MS / MPhil Programs:** 16 years of education (BS 4-years or Master degree) with minimum 2.5 CGPA or 2nd Division, plus GAT General / University departmental test.
## Merit Lists & Selection
- Merit lists are published officially online at: https://ul.edu.pk/program_merit_list
- Selected candidates must submit original documents and semester fee before the due date to secure admission.
## Student Enrollments & University Strength
- **Academic Scope:** 62 degree programs across 5 faculties and 22 departments.
- **Student Body & Enrollments:** The University of Layyah educates several thousand students enrolled across morning and evening undergraduate, postgraduate, and diploma programs.
- Exact semester-wise enrollment quotas and seat allocations for each program are managed dynamically each admission cycle by the Directorate of Academics and Registrar Office.

text:
University of Layyah - Facilities, Scholarships, Hostel & Transport
# University of Layyah - Facilities, Scholarships, Hostel & Transport
## Transport Facility
- The university provides dedicated bus services covering multiple routes in Layyah city and surrounding areas:
- Karor Lal Esan route
- Kot Sultan route
- Fatehpur route
- Chowk Azam route
- Layyah City central stops
- Transport office contact: Available during university hours for bus pass issuance.
## Hostel Accommodation
- University offers hostel accommodation for outstation students (Boys and Girls hostels) with 24/7 security, mess facility, and study rooms.
- Hostel details and application forms: https://ul.edu.pk/page/faculty-hostel
## Scholarships & Financial Assistance
- **PEEF Scholarships:** Punjab Educational Endowment Fund scholarships for needy and meritorious students.
- **Ehsaas Undergraduate Scholarship:** Full tuition fee waiver plus monthly stipend for deserving undergraduate students.
- **HEC Need-Based Scholarships:** Financial aid for underprivileged students.
- **University Merit Scholarships:** Semester-wise fee concessions for top position holders in each department.
- Details at: https://ul.edu.pk/page/Scholarships
## Student Portal & Fee Challan

- Fee Challan generator: https://ul.edu.pk/challan

Syllabus for the Recruitment Test for Teaching and Non-Teaching Posts
1. Assistant Professor (BPS-19) in Mathematics
• Real Analysis
• Complex Analysis
• Numerical Analysis
• Functional Analysis
• Algebra and Group Theory
2. Assistant Professor (BPS-19) Islamic Studies (23 candidates)
· Quranic Sciences (Aloom al Quran)
· Hadith Sciences (Aloom al Hadith)
· Study of Fiqh & Sharia law
· Seerah Studies
· Study of World Religions
3. Lecturer (BPS-18) in Animal Nutrition
• Basic Principles of Animal Nutrition
• Digestion, Absorption, Metabolism of Carbohydrates, Protein, Fats
• Ruminants Feeding and Nutrition
• Physiology and Biochemistry of Nutrition (chicken vs ruminants)
• Feed Manufacturing Technology
• Feed Milling Operations
• Nutrition of Dairy Cattle
• Minerals and Vitamins in Animal Nutrition
• Feed Evaluation and Formulation
• Analytical Techniques in Animal Nutrition
4 &5. Assistant (BPS-16) and Junior Clerk (BPS-11)
